job.title: Part Time Warehouse Coordinator/Supervisor
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Supervisor/Coordinator for this permanent part-time opportunity with a well-established SMEATON GRANGE company.

Working 25-30 hours per week you would take ownership of all day to day warehouse operations including:  

  • Unload incoming freight, checking for any damage
  • Verify stock against picking slips and report any discrepancies
  • Prepare and load orders for deliveries
  • Rotate stock, as required
  • Carry out regular stock counts to ensure accuracy of stock
  • All associated admin including use of of ERP/WMS type systems
  • All associated housekeeping to ensure warehouse is kept clean and tidy and in good order
  • Forklift licence is essential

If you have a minimum of 5 years experience in a similar role, ideally one where you have been responsible for the day to day operation and coordination of a warehouse from end to end, we’d love to hear from you.  

Interested? Simply APPLY NOW!

job.title: Temp Procurement Officer (cost optimisation project)
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Procurement Officer for a 4-5 week temporary assignment with a well-established SMEATON GRANGE business.

Working closely with management, you will review existing supplier arrangements, source alternate providers and identify opportunities to achieve cost savings for the business. 

Responsibilities:
·       Review current supplier arrangements, pricing and contracts
·       Contact existing suppliers to discuss pricing and negotiate improved rates
·       Research and identify alternative suppliers and service providers
·       Obtain, analyse, and compare competitive quotations
·       Review expenditure across a range of areas such as local and international freight, warehousing, utilities, and general business services
·       Assess value for money, service quality, and overall supplier performance
·       Present recommendations and potential cost savings to management
·       Maintain accurate records of supplier comparisons, negotiations and potential savings achieved

The type of person we are looking for would have a solid background in procurement, sourcing or a similar role and ideally has had experience  negotiating  with freight/logistics/warehousing providers.

If you have relevant skills and experience, and are available to commit to a 4-5 week assignment, we’d love to hear from you. Simply APPLY NOW!

Candidates living around SMEATON GRANGE, GREGORY HILLS, ORAN PARK, INGLEBURN, MINTO, LEPPINGTON and surrounds will find this role within a very easy drive. On-site parking is provided.
